posts.hook: machine-made math is now being built on top of other machine-made math
posts.caption: an outside researcher and claude posted new complexity separations that all depend on anthropic's unreviewed vp vs vnp claim, china telecom showed a 285b model trained entirely on huawei chips, and binance says every withdrawal is open again four weeks after its $6.3b hack. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: a mostly ai-written paper claims new complexity separations, checked in 36,000 lines of lean
slides.desc: every result is ==conditional== on anthropic's vp vs vnp claim, which no human has checked

terms.gloss: software that checks a mathematical proof step by step
an algebraic cousin of the p vs np question about hard problems

slides.title: china telecom trains a 285b-parameter open model on 8,192 huawei chips, ==no nvidia==
slides.desc: the other side of us export curbs: a large model trained on a fully domestic stack

slides.title: binance says its recovery is complete and all withdrawals are open again
slides.desc: four weeks after hackers stole a record $6.3b from the exchange, reuters reports

slides.title: a console hacker published slides on booting linux on the playstation 5
slides.desc: two hypervisor flaws, then mostly driver work: underneath, a ps5 is a standard amd computer

terms.gloss: the layer sony uses to protect the console's core software

slides.title: a free python script writes deletion letters to more than 750 registered data brokers
slides.desc: its readme is frank: it can report a broker says it deleted your data, not that it did

slides.title: nari labs compresses a 27b coding model from 53.8gb to ==10.1gb==
slides.desc: capable local models keep falling toward gaming-pc hardware. the numbers are the project's own

posts.hook: two breaches in one evening: the air force's cloud and sap's source code
posts.caption: reuters sources say hackers breached cloud one, the us air force's main cloud platform, sap confirmed a security incident after suspicious activity on its github, and bloomberg reports restricted nvidia blackwell chips were installed in a shanghai data center linked to megaspeed. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: hackers breached cloud one, the us air force's flagship cloud platform, reuters sources say
slides.desc: it combines microsoft, amazon, oracle and google clouds to power air force applications

slides.title: sap confirms a security incident after suspicious activity on its github
slides.desc: a report says stolen employee tokens let hackers copy and ==alter== source code. sap has not confirmed that

terms.gloss: digital keys that let software sign in as a particular person

slides.title: restricted nvidia blackwell chips turn up in a shanghai data center, bloomberg reports
slides.desc: serial numbers in chinese filings tie the site to megaspeed, the firm the nvidia scandal revolves around

terms.gloss: the nvidia ai chip generation barred from sale to china

slides.title: intel was told the government's 10% stake was ==not a negotiation==, lawsuit notes show
slides.desc: a commerce lawyer said refusing would have consequences he could not predict, per ars technica

slides.title: us smartphone shipments fell ==9%== in the third quarter as memory prices hit android makers
slides.desc: hardest at the low end, counterpoint says, while apple's share rose from 50% to 57%

slides.title: zvi mowshowitz on gpt-6.2 astra: it solves very hard problems, then struggles with what you wanted
slides.desc: one reviewer's read, but he says feedback on openai's new model has been mostly negative

slides.title: bruce schneier: the recent run of outages was not an attack. the cause is economic
slides.desc: reliability is a cost with no near-term profit, so systems run at the edge of working
